If C is a rigid fusion category and Γ(C) = {Vi | i ∈I} is a set of representatives of isomorphism classes of simple objects of C, then E ∼= M i∈I Vi ⊗V ∗ i , and for every X ∈C the structure morphism jX : E →X ⊗X∗is given by jX =   n(X,i) X a=1 ιa ⊗(πa)∗   i∈I where {ιa ∈C(Vi, X) | 1 ⩽a ⩽n(X, i)} and {πa ∈C(X, Vi) | 1 ⩽a ⩽n(X, i)} are dual bases with respect to composition. Furthermore, if U ∈C is a dinatural transformation of target K with structure morphisms dX : U →X ⊗X∗, then the unique morphism eU : U →E making (8) into a commutative diagram is given by eU := (dVi)i∈I .
